_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, pages-installable-offline-and-mobile (T08, REQ-BQOM-006). Declares exportJob.includeMobileProject and exportJob.mobileBundleId, set by ExportJobService::queue(). OpenRegister drops a property a schema does not declare, so without this the choice never reaches RunExportJob.

includeMobileProject.title: Include mobile app project
includeMobileProject.description: Whether the exported tree gets mobile/: a Capacitor wrapper project for the iOS and Android app stores that opens this instance's run page of the app. Buildiq builds, signs and publishes nothing.

mobileBundleId.title: Mobile bundle id
mobileBundleId.description: The bundle id of the mobile app project, such as nl.example.toezicht. Empty means nl.<instance-host>.<slug>.
